subject: Post-discovery: Decision map, legal lanes, and proposed redline order
messages:
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Aisha Khan <aisha.khan@helioshealth.com>; Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: 
Date: Sun, 3 Oct 2027 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap + proposed legal routing (NDA -> MSA -> DPA)

Hi Aisha — great conversation today. Thanks for walking through Helios’ ingestion volumes and the pilot scope. Quick recap and suggested next steps so we’re all aligned.

Recap
- Pilot: 3-month evaluation, ~2M tokens/month expected; peak batch loads for scheduling use case.
- Success criteria: latency <= 250ms (95th pct), cost target <$0.002/token, and HIPAA-friendly controls for data-in-transit.
- Decision team: you (procurement lead), Dr. Patel (clinical lead), Ravi Sharma (IT/security), and your in-house counsel (contracts).

Proposed legal / procurement path (recommendation)
1) NDA (one-way) — to unblock demos and sample data sharing; aim 2 business days for review.
2) MSA (commercial terms) — run parallel pricing and tech SOW discussions; ask for 7–10 business days turn on initial redlines.
3) DPA (data processing annex) — follow MSA redline, privacy/security owners to review; 5 business days target.

Questions / asks
- Can you confirm the internal owner(s) for contracts and security? We typically route NDA first while MSA is under review.
- If you prefer a different order (MSA before NDA), let us know — we can accommodate.

I've attached a draft NDA and our current MSA & DPA annex for your legal team to look at.

Next steps
- Aisha to confirm POC decision maker and legal contact(s) by Tue 10/05.
- Redwood (Ben + me) will stand by for initial redline; we’ll track via HubSpot + shared Drive.

Thanks,
Sergio
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0182

Thanks, Sergio — helpful summary. A few datapoints from our side:
- Procurement lead (contracts): Priya Desai (procurement@helioshealth.com). She handles NDAs and MSAs.
- Security/Privacy: Ravi Sharma (cc’d) will own the DPA review.
- Timeline constraints: our counsel is thin this quarter; typical turnaround for MSAs is 10–12 business days unless we follow a template.

We’re fine with NDA first to speed technical onboarding. I’ll share the names of any additional stakeholders by EOD. Can you confirm whether Redwood is open to our standard MSA clause on indemnity limits (we usually cap at $2M for pilots)?

Subject: Re: Fwd: Post-call recap + proposed legal routing (Helios) — intake notes

Thanks for the context. Quick intake notes and recommended playbook: 

1) Routing and owners (recommended)- NDA: Redwood legal associate (me) -> Helios counsel; target 48 hours on a standard one-way NDA.- MSA: Assign to small-deal playbook. I can prioritize the pilot MSA; target first-pass redline in 5 business days if we use our pilot appendix (limits scope and liability).- DPA: Handed to privacy lead after MSA initial redline; target 3–5 business days for DPA review if standard controls suffice.

2) Liability / indemnity- For pilots, we can offer a $2M liability cap limited to direct damages and only while pilot active. We’ll add language that further commercial deployments re-evaluate limits.

3) Suggested redline sequencing (to minimize back-and-forth)- Send NDA for immediate signature (unilateral if needed).- Simultaneously send MSA with a pilot appendix and proposed liability cap. Ask Helios to provide redlines to MSA in one consolidated round.- Once parties converge on MSA economics/terms, finalize DPA (privacy team to confirm any changes).

4) Turn times and escalation- NDA: 0–2 business days.- MSA first pass: 5 business days (if we push legal priority).- MSA consolidation round: additional 3–7 business days depending on Helios counsel.- DPA: 3–5 business days.

5) Operational ask- Sergio/Ben: please provide a one-page SOW (scope, volume, pilot success criteria) and highlight any non-standard security requirements by EOD. I’ll attach a pilot appendix to the MSA template and turn first-pass redline once received.

I’m flagging this as expedited; will coordinate with privacy and commercial counsel.

—Marissa
Senior Counsel, Contracts | Redwood Inference
